name: noisemaker-for-blender-tools
description: Offline tooling for Noisemaker for Blender. These scripts import the reference engine at NM_REFERENCE_ROOT, the unchanged JS Noisemaker compiler, to export golden render-graph JSON from DSL and to regenerate the add-on's effect definitions and transpiled shaders. No build step is required; the reference is plain ESM run under Node only for tooling.
